name: Craftopia – Handmade E-Commerce Website
description: Developed a responsive handmade-products e-commerce website featuring 30+ products, product detail pages, search, category and price filtering, sorting, shopping cart, wishlist, customer reviews, and WhatsApp-based ordering. Integrated Firebase Authentication and Cloud Firestore for user authentication and product reviews.

name: FreshSip – Responsive Juice Ordering Website
description: Designed and developed a responsive fruit juice ordering website with a modern user interface, product pages, navigation, reusable layouts, and mobile-friendly design. Implemented a JavaScript shopping cart with quantity updates, item removal, total calculation, and local storage for cart persistence.
